preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(n) <= 2000 and 2 <= int(m) <= 2000 and 1 <= int(w) <= 10**9 for n, m, w in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[0].split()])
preconditions.description: Input dimensions n and m are integers between 2 and 2000 inclusive, and w is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == int(n) + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == int(m) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input grid has exactly n rows, each with exactly m space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= int(a_ij) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a_ij in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each cell value a_ij is an integer between -1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The start cell (1,1) and end cell (n,m) are free (not -1).

postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no path exists) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum time to reach school.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.strip()) == min_time or int(stdout.strip()) == -1 for min_time in compute_min_time(stdin))
postconditions.description: If a path exists, the output is the minimum time to traverse from (1,1) to (n,m) using adjacent moves (cost w) and portal teleportation (cost a_ij + a_xy). If no path exists, output is '-1'.
